info.description: High-performance retail POS and inventory management API with RBAC, atomic checkout, and analytics.
info.title: Retail POS & Inventory API

get.description: Ranks sellers by completed sales volume, commission earned, and revenue share percentage for a period. Accessible exclusively to Owner.
Calculates Revenue, Cost of Goods Sold, Gross Profit, Expenses, Commissions, and Net Profit for a period. Accessible exclusively to Owner.
Ranks catalog products by sales volume and total revenue generated for a period. Accessible exclusively to Owner.

post.description: Authenticates user by phone and password, issuing access and refresh tokens.
Validates refresh token, invalidates it (rotation), and issues a new token pair.

get.description: Retrieve operational expenses with filtering by category, date range, and pagination. Accessible exclusively to Owner.

post.description: Record a store operational expense (rent, utilities, salaries, marketing, etc.). Accessible exclusively to Owner.

delete.description: Permanently delete an erroneously recorded expense by UUID. Accessible exclusively to Owner.

get.description: Browse sales orders with optional filters. Sellers only see their own receipts.

parameters.description: Filter by status: completed or refunded
parameters.name: status

post.description: Creates sales receipt with atomic stock decrement and commission snapshot.

get.description: Retrieve receipt details with items. Sellers can only view their own receipts.

post.description: Issues a full refund, restocks inventory, and sets order status to refunded (Owner only).

get.description: Browse catalog with optional search, low stock filter, and pagination. Cost price is masked to 0.00 for sellers.

parameters.description: Filter by name or SKU substring
parameters.name: search

post.description: Register a new product in the catalog (Owner only).

get.description: Find a product by its scanned QR code barcode. Cost price is masked to 0.00 for sellers.

put.description: Modify properties of an existing product in the catalog (Owner only).

get.description: Generates and streams PNG image barcode encoding product's QR code (Owner only).
Returns a list of all seller accounts and their commission rates (Owner only).

post.description: Creates a new seller user with custom commission percentage (Owner only).

get.description: Returns the calling seller's total sales volume, commission rate, and accumulated commissions for a period. Accessible to Sellers and Owners.

patch.description: Updates the commission rate percentage for a specific seller (Owner only).

get.description: Returns the operational status of the service and database

BearerAuth.description: Type "Bearer" followed by a space and JWT token.
BearerAuth.name: Authorization
